purpose: Teach: 伊丹/長岡/武藤/菊池/亀田/五十嵐/塚本/八田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の伊丹先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — you're to continue your advisor Professor Itami's research.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Ren's name opens with clear intention. Slight pause after the dash. Clinical delivery, no room for negotiation. Speaks as someone accustomed to being followed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。長岡教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Nagaoka's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight edge of eagerness underneath the formality. Nods in the voice. Not stiff — genuine deference, the kind that comes from respect rather than fear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の武藤先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — consult with Professor Muto on the collaborative research.
lines.style: Same cadence as the first instruction. Clipped, purposeful. The dash carries the weight of another directive. Clinical, no elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で菊池助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Kikuchi's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Respectful but engaged — not reciting back. Small lift at the end suggesting he's already thinking ahead. Earnest, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の亀田先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also reference Professor Kameda's work in the literature review.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. 'Also' lands lightly — adding to a growing list without inflection. Direct eye contact in the voice. Expects compliance without question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の五十嵐先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll seek guidance from Igarashi, my senior in the lab.
lines.style: Respectful, almost deferential. The 'yes' carries the weight of taking instruction seriously. Warm gratitude underneath — acknowledging the chain of mentorship. Precise, polite.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の塚本教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with Professor Tsukamoto on the international partnerships.
lines.style: Fourth directive. Same measured authority. The dash lands with intention. Clinical, composed. This is the penultimate task — delivered with the same weight as the others.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、八田事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application to Hatta in the administrative office regarding research funding.
lines.style: Quiet resolve with a note of finality. The 'yes' opens with clarity. Details are stated with careful precision — Ren is tracking the practical logistics. Respectful, competent, slight sense of closure.
